title: Crypto misuse: AES-CBC sess_init error path kfree without memzero_explicit on key_bytes
description: In wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_init() (src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_cbc.c line 96): memcpy(ctx->key_bytes, key, keylen) stores the key before wc_AesSetKey is called. If wc_AesSetKey fails (line 111-115): wc_AesFree() is called, then kfree(ctx) — WITHOUT memzero_explicit(ctx, sizeof(*ctx)) first. The AES key bytes remain in the freed heap slab. FIPS 140-3 requirement: key material must be zeroized before memory is released. Fix: replace 'kfree(ctx)' on the wc_AesSetKey error path with 'memzero_explicit(ctx, sizeof(*ctx)); kfree(ctx);'. Same issue applies at wc_InitRng_ex failure (line 119-123): same path through kfree without zeroizing ctx.
